class.name: TamaServerBulletConfig
class.brief_description: A Resource that configures the appearance and collision of a server bullet type.
class.description:
[b]TamaServerBulletConfig[/b] defines the visual and physics properties for a server bullet type. Register it in [TamaBulletRegistry] under the [member TamaBulletRegistry.objects] dictionary, or imperatively via [method TamaManager.register_server_bullet].
Server bullets are rendered as a [MultiMesh] (one draw call per batch), making them suitable for large bullet counts (hundreds to thousands simultaneously). Collision is a per-frame CPU circle test against the tracked player position — no PhysicsServer2D bodies are created.
[b]Texture and animation[/b] are defined by a [TamaAnimatedTexture] resource set on [member texture]. For a static bullet use a single-frame [TamaAnimatedTexture]; for an animated sprite use multiple frames with [member TamaAnimatedTexture.fps] > 0. The [member TamaAnimatedTexture.blend_mode] controls how the bullet type is composited (e.g. additive for glows).
[b]Spawn animation[/b] plays during the optional [member spawn_delay] freeze period. The spawn sprite starts at [member starting_spawn_scale] / [member starting_spawn_opacity] and lerps to scale 1 / opacity 1 by the end of the delay. Set [member spawn_texture] to a [TamaAnimatedTexture] for a custom spawn effect; it renders above the bullet and supports its own blend mode.

members.member: Animated texture used to render the bullet. A single-frame [TamaAnimatedTexture] produces a static sprite. All bullets of a type share the same animation phase. The [member TamaAnimatedTexture.blend_mode] is applied to the entire type.

When [code]true[/code] (default), [member rect] is automatically derived from the first frame's pixel size whenever [member texture] is assigned. Set to [code]false[/code] to specify [member rect] manually.
Local-space quad size and pivot offset. When [member auto_rect] is [code]true[/code] this is overwritten automatically and shown read-only in the inspector.
Scales the rendered sprite relative to [member rect]. Use this to shrink or grow the visual without changing the collision circle.
Radius of the circular collision shape in pixels, used for the CPU player-hit test.
When [code]true[/code], each bullet's sprite rotates with its angle. When [code]false[/code], [member face_velocity] has no effect.

When [code]true[/code] and [member rotates] is [code]true[/code], the sprite faces the actual velocity direction (the combination of [code]angle[/code]/[code]speed[/code] and lateral acceleration). Read-only in the inspector when [member rotates] is [code]false[/code].

Physics frames to freeze the bullet before it starts moving. During this window the spawn animation plays and collision is suppressed. Can be overridden per-fire with the [code]delay[/code] statement in TamaScript.

Animated texture for the spawn effect. Rendered above the bullet during [member spawn_delay]. Supports its own [member TamaAnimatedTexture.blend_mode]. Falls back to the first frame of [member texture] when not set.
Scale of the spawn sprite at the first frame of the delay. Lerps to [code]1.0[/code] by the end of the delay.
Opacity of the spawn sprite at the first frame of the delay. Lerps to [code]1.0[/code] by the end of the delay.
Maximum number of simultaneously active bullets of this type. Bullets fired beyond this limit are silently dropped.
Distance in pixels past the screen edge before a bullet is recycled. Overridden by [member TamaManager.global_out_of_bounds_margin] when that value is ≥ 0.
